items.description: Audibase is an audio social network. With this application available on iTunes, users can upload, comment, and share in an online community. The app aims to be particularly useful for journalists, coaches, and interviewers because it records until 2 hours of audio material.
Takes a BBC Programme search and converts the results in to iCal format for use in Google Calendar.
Manage, monitor, and control your (mt) Media Temple services on your Android device. More details at droiddevil.com
Automate Google AdWords reporting in Microsoft Excel.
Uses route planning in Google Maps API to enable you to plan your route to a Premier Inn Hotel.
Droidin is first ever LinkedIn app on Android platform. After 2 years and 3 incarnations it is entirely LinkedIn API based and continues be the most full featured LinkedIn app on the Android market
Mashup that uses the new Flickr API video features to let you browse the newest videos on Flickr.
Enter your search terms and then see 50 thumbnails of videos. Hover over one for a description and click it to play the video. Also lists web, news, blog, image, and book search results.

Lose It! is a mobile application related to weight loss available on Google Play and Apple iTunes. Besides identity, location, media, and camera, the app also needs access to In-app purchases. Once installed, the app asks for user weight, followed by goal weight, gender, height, and weight plan.
Send visual voicemail to any Twitter user with Pockets App and Twilio.
Interactive map that presents a balanced view of industrial environmental performance.
Measure and share real-time local Twitter trends. App uses Twitter, Google Maps and Yahoo Term Extraction APIs.
New Zealand garage sale application using Google Maps, Facebook and Streetview.

The MyDataBus service provides a simple way to store, transfer, and share your files online. Data can include photos, videos, and others. Integrates with social tools like Facebook. Integration with Snipshot allows online photo editing.
Google Maps holiday trivia map showing cities and towns in USA: named Turkey, or that claim to be the turkey capital of the US or world, or are named Plymouth, or are named Cranberry.
See all the latest twitters as they are sent.

See Manhattan Nightlife from a bird's eye view and find your scene with our built in real time Twitter feeds and Foursquare Tips/Checkin Data. Check out your favorite spots by Male:Female ratio so you find the night you're looking for.
A map of limo service providers in the USA. Locate a provider in your area and then access information about their company and-or request a free quote.

A real estate search engine that aggregating nearly a million property listings searchable with a GoogleMap-based visual interface. Site has budding online community of buyers, sellers, and service providers.
Directory of holiday rentals, bed and breakfasts, and camp farms in France. Very useful web site for renting and reserving your holiday rental. Many choices for holiday lodging in France.
Learn about the unknown hazards around you - the toxins you may be breathing. PlanetHazard maps over 86,000 companies throughout the US that emit hazardous air pollutants. Excellent mashup.
